This is a bad loop, because it can be an infinite loop. With an equality test, if channels is 255, and `i` is a `uint8_t`, then the test is always true and the loop never exits. Suggestions:

1. Don't use a `uint8_t` as a loop bound.
2. Loop from 0 with strict equality, and make the line below `proto_item_append_text(audio_samples_tree, "  %u", (i + 1)` - note that even if `i` remains a `uint8_t`, integer promotion will cause `i + 1` to be an `int`. (https://en.cppreference.com/c/language/conversion#Integer_promotions)
OSS-Fuzz Issue 546467816

`for(int i = 0; i == (int)channels; i++){
           proto_item_append_text(audio_samples_tree, "  %u", (i + 1));`
